ignoreValues.reason: Claude: border-b-2 + rounded-full + animate-spin is this repo's inline spinner idiom (16 occurrences, goevent-design 13) - a 24px spinning disc, not a rounded card with an accent border. The rule cannot tell the two apart.

Claude triage: not an easing. The rule's curve is cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94) (easeInOutQuad); the detector matched the keyframe NAME. Its overshoot is a -3px/+1px settle on a 15px travel, i.e. a settle rather than a bounce.

False positive: the img is guarded by v-if="resolved && !failed" so it never renders without a resolved URL, and handling the broken case is this component's entire purpose (it falls back to the queue's own missing-asset block on @error).

Claude: L49 is the loading spinner (rounded-full + border-b-2 + animate-spin), the canonical CSS spinner arc, not a card accent. Pre-existing, untouched by this change. The only genuine rounded+border element here is the best-seller card's emerald-300 ring, which the detector does not flag.

intentional design: the category accent rail predates this session (HEAD had inset 3px accent shadow) and the owner's in-progress diff deliberately reworked it into a fading gradient with a documented rationale in the .event-card::before comment
Claude triage: L100 is the standard Tailwind loading spinner (rounded-full + border-b-2 + animate-spin), not an accent border on a card; pre-existing code, not part of this change

Original author's design, documented in the code (commits dc10203c/d1594bd1): the desktop content panel grows its width from 0 so the reveal never sweeps over the icon rail the way a translateX slide did, and .main animates margin-left in step because the frames must actually reflow into the narrower column (a transform would leave their measured width unchanged). Desktop-only, one 0.3s toggle, no continuous animation.
